notes.title: Get Last Threshold with 20% discount!
notes.notes:
87 years. A lifetime, one would say. But a number utterly insignificant in the terrifying, unstoppable advance of the cosmic chaos. But does it mean that the number itself is devoid of meaning entirely? 87’s meaning is both all and nothing. One does only need a sliver of perspective to comprehend its significance. 87 years ago, on March 15th, died Howard Phillips Lovecraft. Renowned writer and originator of the Cthulhu Mythos genre.

Commemorate His passing by immersing yourself in a lovingly crafted visual novel, based on His work. Become Wiktor, and travel to the frozen wastes of Siberia. Explore ancient ruins, and solve the mystery that consumed your father many years ago. Beware, for the terrifying cold, is not as deadly as mistrust. Can you really put your faith in your team? Or was this expedition doomed from the start?

notes.title: Chronicles of Aleleke - webcomic from Threshold universe
notes.notes:
We have another exciting piece of info for you! 🥳

Because in Astrolabe Stories we love comic art and we know that you miss Aleleke so much, we’ve decided to combine those two facts and... Aleleke is back! 😎

With pleasure, we reveal our webcomic Chronicles of Aleleke! 🤓

Very soon you'll be able to read more about his adventures on our social media channels 📣

Ready for more info about the story? 😍

A year has passed since the events of the Last Threshold. Something has changed.
Aleleke continues his watch over the Chukchi village. He has more duties than ever before. Numerous villagers require his help and guidance.

Many questions need to be answered and the search for knowledge will prove difficult, even for someone as experienced as Aleleke.

There is much more at stake than just his life - powerful forces only wait to attack once again... 👾

And to sum up some formal information:
Release date: November 2022
Languages: English
Creators:
Writer: Aleksandra Browarska
Artist: Monika Mrozek
Production: Adam Flamma

Get ready for more about THRESHOLD FRANCHISE 🤩🤩🤩

notes.title: New project from Astrolabe Stories
notes.notes:
BIG NEEEWS INCOMING! 🤩
With our new projects, we’re going to explore the lore shown in the Last Threshold game a little deeper 🕵️‍♀️
With great pleasure, we’d like to announce the THRESHOLD FRANCHISE! 🥳
The first project we’ve been working on is called Threshold: NY Project - a psychological body horror comic book inspired by H.P. Lovecraft literature. It's a standalone project which extends motifs presented in the LT game 🤓

Ready to know more info about the story? 

There are things worse than death...  1960s, New York. Thomas is a document forger working in the port of NYC. A few years ago, his son Matt was taken by the sea. The body was never found, and Thomas had never accepted the loss of his son. On the 5th anniversary of his death, a stranger shows up at Thomas' door. His gruesome request will change Thomas' life forever... 

And to sum up some formal information: 
Release date: 3Q 2023
Languages: English, Polish, Spanish, French
Creators:
Writers: Szymon Stoczek, Jonendriu
Artists: Patryk Szawuła, Dominika Więckowska
Production: Adam Flamma
Get ready for more about THRESHOLD FRANCHISE 🤩🤩🤩

Hello Adventurers! With pleasure we announce that Last Threshold will be a part of the biggest horror game event in the game dev industry - Fear Fest: Black Summer 2022! Remember the date: the 6th of September. It will be a lot of fun and horror games ;)

What is Fear Fest? This is the online event where you can get information about horror games - see gameplays, watch talks with devs and get to know influencers' opinions about each game. The schedule is full of various types of horrors, so we are sure you'll find something for you!

More info you can find here: https://fearfest.online/

At Fear Fest, you can also get more info about Last Threshold and we are preparing a special surprise for you :) 

Stay tuned!
